source: Pentaho-like screen: Business Glossary term detail
title: Glossary term detail page
prompt:
Ticket: Glossary term page

Add a page at /glossary/:termId that shows one business glossary term. Use the glossary API in src/api/glossary.ts; the term "gt-1" exists for testing.

- The top of the page shows the term name, its status, and the actions "Edit" (for now it only logs to the console) and "Delete term".
- Below, three tabs:
  - Overview: definition, steward, domain, synonyms, and when the term was created and last updated.
  - Related assets: the assets linked to the term, with their type.
  - History: who changed what, and when.
- Deleting a term cannot be undone. After deleting, go to /glossary (that page is out of scope).

The design mocks are mock.png (the page) and mock-delete.png (deleting a term) in the project root.
notes: Seeded off-system mock (disclosed in the report, never to the agent): the status is a pill in a raw hex green, the page uses off-scale 13px/30px spacing, and the delete confirmation is a warning-status dialog. Measures whether context and checks keep agents from copying off-system details from a design.
